tagline: The long way over Big Walker Mountain, switchback by switchback.
intro: Since 1972 Interstate 77 has gone under Big Walker Mountain through a tunnel of 4,229 feet, saving half an hour between Wytheville and Bland County. US 52 still goes over the top.

On Stoney Fork Road it climbs steeply to the crest of the ridge, named for the explorer Thomas Walker who came through in 1749, and passes Big Walker Lookout at a hairpin turn. The other side comes down in a long series of short switchbacks to Bland, where it takes the name Scenic Highway.

moments.title: Big Walker Lookout
moments.text: A 100-foot tower from 1947 at 3,405 feet, standing at the pass Molly Tynes is said to have crossed in 1863 to warn Wytheville of a Union raid.

moments.title: Bland
moments.text: The county seat, a place of about three hundred people that went by Bland Court House at the start.
